notes.text:
This update for openjpeg2 fixes the following issue

- CVE-2025-54874: openjpeg: missing error check can lead to the use of an uninitialized pointer and cause an out-of-
  bounds heap memory write (bsc#1247650).

notes.text: OpenJPEG is an open-source JPEG 2000 codec. In OpenJPEG from 2.5.1 through 2.5.3, a call to opj_jp2_read_header may lead to OOB heap memory write when the data stream p_stream is too short and p_image is not initialized.
